title: Owner-facing route dry-run CLI
question_or_target: Ship an ast route CLI that answers, for an arbitrary query string, exactly what the router would select, with confidence, explanation and near-misses - WITHOUT injecting anything.

evidence.claim: Three documented dry runs (two SELECTED, one NO-CAPABILITY-FITS) exit 0 with structured JSON on stdout and injection_performed=false.

evidence.claim: Every flag printed by `ast route --help` parses; --inject and an undocumented flag are rejected (CLI contract).
A documented example in the help text is executed verbatim by probe2; the reviewer runs only those examples.
Capability body canaries never appear on stdout; the CLI shares router.route.route_query and does not start a session.
No-fit is terminal: the weather query returns NO-CAPABILITY-FITS with near-misses rather than injecting a weak match.
